title: Shadows in the Gallery
description: A star-studded private gala at a world-famous Santa Fe art museum ends in tragedy when a renowned collector is murdered. Amid priceless paintings and desert nights, jealousy, forgery, and hidden affairs come to light in this elegant and deadly mystery.
core_plot: During the high-society gala, famous art collector Eleanor Voss is found stabbed in a restricted gallery. A valuable painting is missing.
motive_summary: Art forgery, romantic betrayal, and financial desperation drive the crime.
twist_ending: The stolen painting was a fake all along. Eleanor was about to expose a major forgery ring — the real masterpiece was safely hidden elsewhere.

curator.guilty: Eleanor discovered I had been involved in selling forged artworks. I couldn’t let my career be destroyed.
curator.innocent: I was giving a private tour to donors during the time of the incident.

artist.guilty: Eleanor was going to expose that I had been forging paintings. My entire career was at stake.
artist.innocent: I was showcasing my latest work in the main gallery all evening.

collector.guilty: Eleanor refused to sell me the painting I desperately needed for my collection.
collector.innocent: I was bidding on pieces in the main auction room.

gallerist.guilty: Eleanor found out about my forgery operation and threatened to expose me.
gallerist.innocent: I was busy networking with clients throughout the night.

critic.guilty: Eleanor knew about my unethical dealings and was going to ruin my reputation.
critic.innocent: I was writing notes on the new exhibits all evening.

intern.guilty: Eleanor promised to help my career but then humiliated me publicly.
intern.innocent: I was running errands and helping set up displays most of the night.

clues.clue_text: A gallery security badge with a forged swipe log from 10:45 PM.
clues.importance: Shows unauthorized access to the restricted area.

clues.clue_text: A crumpled auction catalog page with large sums circled and the initials 'V'.
Traces of rare ultramarine pigment on the victim’s clothing and a broken gallery key fob.
clues.importance: Ties someone involved in handling artworks.

accusation_phase: It’s time for accusations! We’ll go around one by one. State your character name clearly and tell us who you believe is the murderer and why.
reveal_phase: The murderer was… [Murderer Name]! Will the accused please stand and read your full confession to the group?
